description: This is a C# source file defining multiple Orleans grain classes with generic parameters, state classes, and interfaces. It includes various grain implementations demonstrating features such as storage providers, generics, concurrency, and messaging patterns within an Orleans project.

methods.name: GetA
methods.description: Returns the property A from the grain state or fields.

methods.name: SetA
methods.description: Sets the property A in the grain state or fields.

methods.name: SetB
methods.description: Sets the property B in the grain state.

methods.name: GetAxB
methods.description: Returns a string concatenation of properties A and B, with optional parameters.

methods.name: EchoAsync
methods.description: Echoes the input entity and updates the state.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Handles state transitions for a generic reducer.

methods.name: Go
methods.description: Executes a grain handling logic with given state and action.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Simple method to test communication, returning the input.

methods.name: ScheduleDelayedPing
methods.description: Schedules a delayed ping to another grain.

methods.name: GetLastValue
methods.description: Returns the last value set or processed in the grain.

methods.name: LongRunningTask
methods.description: Performs a delay and then returns a value, demonstrating long-running operation.

methods.name: GetRuntimeInstanceId
methods.description: Returns the runtime identity of the current Orleans grain.
